The Tamil Nadu Government M.G.R. Film

Department of Information and Public Relations.

Taramani, Chennai, the Tamil Nadu Government

M.G.R. Film and Television Institute is the State

Government's only film education institution

dedicated to providing systematic training in film

production, film and television technology,

technical and artistic skills and creative

excellence.

96

For over 65 years, the Institute has played

a pivotal role in nurturing skilled technicians,

artists and media professionals who have

contributed significantly to the growth of the film

and television industries.

Since the 2016–2017 academic year, four-

year Bachelor of Visual Arts (B.V.A.) degree

programmes in six disciplines have been offered

under the affiliation of the Tamil Nadu Dr. J.

Jayalalithaa Music and Fine Arts University. Since

the 2019–2020 academic year, students who

successfully complete these programmes have

been awarded the Bachelor of Visual Arts (B.V.A.)

degree.

STUDENTS ADMISSION

A total of 84 students are admitted annually

across six degree programmes. The annual tuition

fee for each programme is Rs.18,000. Students

belonging to the Adi-Dravidar and Scheduled

Tribe communities are eligible for a full tuition fee

accepted through the Institute's website:

www.filminstitute.tn.gov.in

students at the Tamil Nadu Government M.G.R.

Film and Television Training Institute, the

Government provides financial assistance of

Rupees One lakh for each short film. Every year,

students are divided into groups to produce 14

short films as part of their final project.

Film Awards to recognise outstanding student

Film Processor for the short films produced by its

students. Each award recipient receives a shield,

a certificate and a cash prize of Rs.25,000/-.

Best Animation and Visual Effects Creator award

from the 2024-2025 academic year onward.
